$schema_note: Machine-readable tracking plan. Generated by docs/data/tools/build-tracking-plan.mjs from events-a.mjs and events-b.mjs; edit those, not this file.

conventions.event_name: snake_case object_action, past tense, one fact per event (page_viewed, proof_approved). No UI-widget names, no vendor names.
conventions.property_name: snake_case; units as suffix (_ms, _usd, _cents, _bytes, _chars, _s); booleans start with is_/has_ or are plain adjectives; ids end in _id and are opaque
conventions.money: customer money in integer cents (_cents); model/API cost in decimal USD (_usd), taken from OpenRouter usage.cost
conventions.time: UTC ISO-8601 occurred_at set where the fact happened; received_at set by the collector
conventions.enums: lower_snake_case, closed lists, extending a list is a minor version bump; unknown values rejected by ingest_event
conventions.free_text: never an event property. Record length (_chars), presence (has_*) or a controlled reason code
conventions.versioning: schema_version per event; additive changes keep the version; renames or semantic changes bump it and keep the old one for 90 days
conventions.dedupe: event_id is a client- or server-generated UUIDv7; (event_id, occurred_at) is unique, so a retry must resend the same occurred_at

envelope.note: first-party cookie gh_aid; absent for webhook/worker events
pseudonym from privacy.subjects; never the auth uid

identity.anonymous_id: random UUID in first-party cookie gh_aid (365 days) set only when analytics is allowed; if not allowed, no id is set and client events are dropped, server events for commerce and operations still carry subject_id
identity.guest_subject: Supabase anonymous sign-in uid maps to a subject_id at first server contact (privacy.subjects, is_guest = true)
stitching: signup (upgrade in place): same auth uid, is_guest false, no merge needed
login to an existing account from a guest session: privacy.merge_subjects(guest, existing)
backfill: events with the anonymous_id and null subject_id are updated at link time
identity.cross_device: only via login; no probabilistic or fingerprint matching, ever
identity.ad_platforms: no identifiers sent from creator/proof/cart/account; server purchase events limited to what the attorney approves

sensitivity_classes.name: System/operational
sensitivity_classes.examples: job ids, model names, cost, latency, status codes, printer states

sensitivity_classes.name: Pseudonymous behaviour
sensitivity_classes.examples: event stream keyed by subject_id/anonymous_id, enumerated brief choices, order facts without identifiers
sensitivity_classes.default_retention: 13 months raw, order facts per finance rules

sensitivity_classes.name: Personal identifiers
sensitivity_classes.examples: email, name, address, phone, IP, user agent, character first names, recipient names
sensitivity_classes.default_retention: per operational schedule; never in analytics or ml

sensitivity_classes.name: User-authored or user-derived text
sensitivity_classes.examples: story idea, memory, inside jokes, card message, chat turns, free-text feedback, story text with names
sensitivity_classes.storage: operational DB; ml.text_samples only if T1+ and scrubbed

sensitivity_classes.name: Likeness (restricted)
sensitivity_classes.examples: uploaded photos, identity sheets, model sheets, any generated art derived from a photo of a person, anything depicting a minor
sensitivity_classes.storage: private object storage only, never copied to analytics/ml
sensitivity_classes.default_retention: 90-day photo purge; Saved Person 24 months inactivity; order art 12 months

sensitivity_classes.name: Prohibited: never collected or derived
sensitivity_classes.examples: face embeddings, face geometry, face-match results, age/gender/ethnicity inference from images, EXIF GPS, card numbers, session replay of creator pages, keystroke capture

consent_tiers.name: Operational (always on)
consent_tiers.basis: needed to run, secure, price and support the service; disclosed in the Privacy Policy
allowed: C0 and C1 events in the tracking plan
enumerated brief choices and counts/lengths of free text
reason-code feedback tied to a generation
never: third-party ad tags on creator/proof/cart/account pages
consent_tiers.ui: none beyond the privacy notice; honour account-level analytics opt-out and GPC for any third-party tool
consent_tiers.legal_gate: attorney confirms T0 notice wording and that first-party analytics needs no banner choice

consent_tiers.name: Help improve GreetHub (opt-in)
consent_tiers.basis: separate, unticked, revocable checkbox E, off by default (proposed)
allowed: scrubbed story/message text and edit before/after pairs (ml.text_samples)
chat user turns after PII scrub
used for: prompt design, evals, quality scorer for TEXT, recommendations
never: use for training or fine-tuning a model (that is T2)
consent_tiers.ui: Settings toggle plus one unticked line at proof approval; wording to attorney
consent_tiers.legal_gate: attorney approves wording and scrub standard

consent_tiers.name: Allow training use (opt-in, blocked)
consent_tiers.basis: separate checkbox F, hidden in the UI until a row exists in privacy.legal_signoffs for the scope
allowed: only items passing every gate in ml.training_candidates: T2 consent + legal sign-off + PII scan + moderation clean + NOT photo-derived + NOT likeness + NOT minors-possible
never: any content from a creation that used uploaded photos
any art depicting a real person or a minor
retroactive use of data collected under T0/T1
use of box D (marketing display) as training consent
consent_tiers.legal_gate: written attorney opinion per scope (see 05 gates), vendor-terms review for any distillation from third-party model outputs

consent_tiers.name: Never collected or used for training
never: photos of any person, especially minors
faces, face geometry, embeddings, face-derived attributes
consent_tiers.legal_gate: not unlockable by consent in this plan; only a fresh attorney opinion plus a separate parent-signed release could reopen it, and this plan does not propose it

kpis.NSM_funnel: North star: successful orders per week
kpis.A4_agent_orders: Orders and spend through AI assistants (agent API)
kpis.B2_signup_to_start: Sign-up to creator start (CFO Inputs B13)
kpis.C1_start_to_purchase: Creator start to purchase (CFO Inputs B14)
kpis.U1_cost_per_creation: Model cost per creation (CFO Model Costs)
kpis.U5_print_ship_cost: Print and ship cost (CFO SKU table)
kpis.F3_refund_reprint_rate: Refund and reprint rate (CFO Inputs B36-37)

events.name: page_viewed
events.trigger: Route change on any page once analytics is allowed. On pages that show photos or children's names only the first-party collector runs, never third-party tags.
events.note: Query strings are stripped to the allowlisted utm_* keys. Ad click ids (fbclid, gclid) are never stored in analytics tables.

properties.name: page_type
properties.description: Coarse page class, never the raw URL path

properties.name: template_id
properties.description: Template slug when page_type is template_detail

properties.name: referrer_host
properties.description: Host only, no path or query

properties.name: channel
properties.description: Derived from utm/referrer using the CMO CSV channel names

events.name: attribution_captured
events.trigger: First request of a new anonymous_id carrying utm/referrer data; writes first_touch on the session and later on the user.

events.name: consent_banner_decided
events.trigger: User accepts, rejects or customises the privacy banner on marketing pages, or a Global Privacy Control signal is detected.
events.attorney_review: Whether first-party operational analytics needs a banner choice at all; GPC handling; equal-weight buttons (legal 06 req 43).

events.name: template_clicked
events.trigger: User clicks a template card in the gallery or on an SEO page.

events.name: creator_started
events.trigger: A draft/creation is created (guest or account) and the first intake step renders.

events.name: guest_preview_requested
events.trigger: Guest hits POST /api/card/preview (before rate-limit and spend-cap checks).

events.name: guest_preview_rendered
events.trigger: Guest preview image returned to the browser (real or mock).

events.name: guest_preview_failed
events.trigger: Preview pipeline failed or was blocked.

events.name: signup_prompt_shown
events.trigger: Upgrade prompt (save, photos, high-res) becomes visible to a guest.

events.name: signup_started
events.trigger: User submits the sign-up form or starts Google OAuth.

events.name: signup_completed
events.trigger: Account created and age confirmation + policy acceptance stored (legal 06 req 1, 51). Triggers identity stitching (privacy.link_anonymous).

events.name: login_completed
events.trigger: Existing user authenticated.

events.name: auth_failed
events.trigger: Magic link expired/used, OAuth error.

events.name: age_gate_failed
events.trigger: 18+ box not ticked at sign-up, or a user states they are under 18 (actual-knowledge handler, legal 06 req 2).
events.attorney_review: Actual-knowledge handling and what, if anything, may be kept after lockout.

events.name: brief_started
events.trigger: First brief field saved for a creation.

events.name: brief_field_completed
events.trigger: A required or optional brief field becomes valid for the first time (server-validated).
events.note: Recipient name, relationship text, character names, story idea, memory, inside jokes, message wording, include/avoid are free text: only value_chars is recorded.

properties.name: field_key
properties.description: Structured field name, never its value for free-text fields

properties.name: value_enum
properties.description: Value only for enumerated fields (occasion, tone, art_style, reading_age, page_count, age_band)

events.name: brief_field_edited
events.trigger: User changes a previously completed field (brief card edit or chat correction).

events.name: brief_completed
events.trigger: missingFields(draft) returns empty; creation becomes generation-ready.

events.name: brief_abandoned
events.trigger: Derived nightly: creation with no activity for 24 h before brief_completed. Not a client event.

events.name: chat_session_started
events.trigger: Greet Guide session opens; AI disclosure shown (legal 06 req 12).

events.name: chat_turn_completed
events.trigger: One user message plus guide reply (POST /api/intake) finishes.
events.note: Message text is never an event property. Chat transcripts live only in the operational draft record under the draft retention rule.

properties.name: user_chars
properties.description: Length of the user message only

events.name: chat_guardrail_triggered
events.trigger: Rule-based or model moderation blocks or rewrites chat/brief text.
events.attorney_review: Retention of the flagged text itself (not stored here); moderation log retention is 12 months in legal 02 s7.

events.name: draft_saved
events.trigger: Account draft persisted (explicit save or autosave milestone).

events.name: consent_modal_shown
events.trigger: Photo-consent modal opens before the first upload.

events.name: consent_recorded
events.trigger: ConsentRecord written (privacy.consent_records). Properties are flags only; IP and UA stay in the consent ledger.
events.attorney_review: Final wording of boxes A-F; whether box E/F consent can be given by an adult for content that depicts a minor.

properties.name: box_f_training
properties.description: Proposed T2 opt-in; UI hidden until legal sign-off

events.name: consent_changed
events.trigger: User toggles improvement/training/marketing/keep-person consent in Settings, or withdraws consent.
events.note: Withdrawal triggers deletion tasks for the affected scope (see 06-data-governance).

events.name: policy_accepted
events.trigger: Terms/Privacy acceptance recorded at signup or checkout (legal 06 req 51).

events.name: photo_upload_started
events.trigger: User picks files in the upload step (after the consent gate passes).
events.note: No client-side face detection, no EXIF, no filenames, no image-derived signal of any kind (biometric risk, legal 02 s5).

events.name: photo_uploaded
events.trigger: Photo stored in private storage after moderation passes.
events.attorney_review: Whether the declared age_band of a depicted child is itself 'known child' data under state law; kept only for purge scheduling and consent coverage.

properties.name: age_band
properties.description: Declared by the user, never inferred from the image

events.name: photo_upload_blocked
events.trigger: Upload rejected: size, type, no consent id, rate limit, or moderation block. CSAM hits are NOT logged here (separate restricted safety log).
events.attorney_review: CSAM procedure and evidence preservation must live outside analytics (legal 02 s8, 06 req 18).

events.name: photo_deleted
events.trigger: A photo is removed (user, purge job, deletion flow, consent withdrawal).

events.name: photo_purge_run
events.trigger: Daily purge job finishes (legal 06 req 25).

properties.name: overdue_count
properties.description: Photos past expires_at that were not deleted

events.name: saved_person_changed
events.trigger: Saved Person created, reused in a creation, deleted or expired.

events.name: story_generated
events.trigger: Story job succeeds (book) or card copy generated.

events.name: story_edited
events.trigger: User saves changes to a story page, title, dedication or card message.
events.note: Edit text diffs are stored only under T1 consent, in ml.text_samples, scrubbed.

properties.name: edit_distance_ratio
properties.description: 0 unchanged, 1 rewritten; computed server-side, text discarded

events.name: story_approved
events.trigger: User approves the story.

events.name: model_sheet_generated
events.trigger: Sheet job succeeds (a version is added).

events.name: model_sheet_redo_requested
events.trigger: User asks to redo the model sheet (free redo or paid reroll).
events.note: Reason 'likeness_off' is feedback about a generated drawing, not a face measurement.

properties.name: has_note
properties.description: Whether a free-text note was typed; text not recorded

events.name: model_sheet_approved
events.trigger: User approves the model sheet; page rendering becomes allowed.

events.name: model_sheet_abandoned
events.trigger: Derived: sheet generated, no approval or redo within 7 days.

events.name: render_job_queued
events.trigger: Job document created.

events.name: render_job_finished
events.trigger: Job reaches succeeded, failed or cancelled.

events.name: generation_attempted
events.trigger: One model call attempt finishes. Mirrors a ledger row; the system of record is ml.generation_attempts and this event exists for funnel joins.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Page id such as p3 or cover

events.name: page_render_finished
events.trigger: A page reaches done or failed after any automatic retries.

events.name: spend_cap_hit
events.trigger: A call is blocked by the per-job, per-user or daily USD cap.

events.name: qa_evaluated
events.trigger: One QA evaluation of a rendered image completes (local border check, vision count/text check, later a learned scorer).

properties.name: notes_code
properties.description: Controlled vocabulary; free-text notes are discarded

events.name: auto_reroll_triggered
events.trigger: QA failure causes the one allowed automatic re-render.

events.name: reroll_requested
events.trigger: User requests a new version of a page or the front of a card.

events.name: reroll_completed
events.trigger: Reroll job finishes.

events.name: page_version_selected
events.trigger: User switches the current version of a page (for example back to an earlier one).
events.note: Feeds ml.preference_pairs (chosen vs rejected attempt ids). No image content involved.

events.name: rating_submitted
events.trigger: Thumb or star on a model sheet, page, story or the finished proof.
events.note: Free text itself is not an event property; stored in ml.text_samples only for T1+ consent.

events.name: proof_viewed
events.trigger: Proof viewer opens.

events.name: layout_job_finished
events.trigger: Print PDFs and preview generated.

events.name: proof_approved
events.trigger: User approves the proof (stores page hashes for evidence, legal 06 req 32).

events.name: proof_link_opened
events.trigger: User arrives from a 'proof ready' email link. Replaces the open-pixel event proof_email_open.
events.attorney_review: Recommend no open-tracking pixels in transactional email; confirm.

events.name: cart_item_added
events.trigger: Item added to cart.

events.name: cart_viewed
events.trigger: Cart page rendered.

events.name: cart_item_removed
events.trigger: Item removed.

events.name: checkout_started
events.trigger: Pending checkout created and Stripe session opened.

events.name: checkout_consent_given
events.trigger: Proof approval + refund policy acceptance at checkout (legal 06 req 39).

events.name: payment_succeeded
events.trigger: Stripe checkout.session.completed processed (idempotent via processedEvents). The only source for purchase counts and for ad-platform conversion sending.
events.attorney_review: What may be sent to ad platforms server-side (value, currency, event_id only vs hashed email); sale/share classification.

events.name: payment_failed
events.trigger: Stripe reports a failed or expired session/payment intent.

events.name: order_created
events.trigger: Order record created from a completed checkout (one per order).

events.name: refund_issued
events.trigger: Refund created in Stripe or via admin.

events.name: dispute_opened
events.trigger: Stripe dispute created.

events.name: fulfillment_submitted
events.trigger: Order item submitted to Lulu/Prodigi.

events.name: fulfillment_status_changed
events.trigger: Printer webhook or poll moves an item/order along the state machine (orderState.ts).

events.name: order_shipped
events.trigger: First shipped status per item.

events.name: order_delivered
events.trigger: Delivered status.

events.name: fulfillment_needs_attention
events.trigger: Item enters needs_attention (reject, error, hold).

events.name: reprint_created
events.trigger: Reprint/reship created for an item.

events.name: delay_notice_sent
events.trigger: Late-delivery notice sent (legal 06 req 37).

events.name: email_sent
events.trigger: Any email handed to Resend.

events.name: email_unsubscribed
events.trigger: One-click unsubscribe or Resend suppression webhook.

events.name: survey_responded
events.trigger: Post-delivery survey submitted (sent 5 days after delivered).

events.name: reminder_opt_in_changed
events.trigger: User adds/removes an occasion reminder.
events.attorney_review: Reminders store a recipient's occasion date; confirm treatment of third-party (recipient) data.

events.name: reorder_started
events.trigger: User starts a creation from a past order or saved Person.

events.name: digital_delivery_completed
events.trigger: Digital card/book downloaded or e-card sent.

events.name: support_contact_created
events.trigger: Support form, email or chat creates a ticket. The ticket body stays in the helpdesk.

events.name: support_ticket_resolved
events.trigger: Ticket closed.

events.name: content_report_submitted
events.trigger: 'Report content / remove a photo of me or my child' form submitted (legal 06 req 22).
events.attorney_review: Takedown/removal SLA (48 h target) and evidence handling.

events.name: data_export_requested
events.trigger: User requests 'download my data'.

events.name: deletion_requested
events.trigger: Delete-my-data or delete-account confirmed (after magic-link confirmation).
events.note: Recorded in privacy.deletion_log without a subject id; no event row survives the deletion it describes (delete_subject removes it).

events.name: deletion_completed
events.trigger: All privacy.deletion_tasks for the request left 'pending'.

events.name: retention_job_run
events.trigger: Nightly privacy.purge_expired() finishes.

events.name: training_candidate_registered
events.trigger: A row enters ml.training_candidates (default status 'quarantined').

events.name: text_moderation_result
events.trigger: Moderation runs on a brief, story, chat message or name field.

events.name: output_check_result
events.trigger: Character/logo/celebrity vision check on a rendered page (legal 06 req 19).

events.name: ip_input_rewritten
events.trigger: IP-safety screening rewrote customer text so a protected character, brand, franchise or slogan became an original idea (docs/legal/07).

properties.name: surface
properties.description: Where the text was typed or produced

properties.name: detected_kinds
properties.description: Kinds only: character, brand, slogan, person, franchise

properties.name: changed_chars
properties.description: Length of the text before minus after, absolute value

events.name: ip_input_blocked
events.trigger: IP-safety screening refused customer text (for example a real public figure) and asked for a different direction.

events.name: ip_output_flagged
events.trigger: Output vision check flagged a rendered page (recognisable protected character, logo, slogan, licensed merchandise or high look-alike risk) or Sonnet-written story text was flagged.

properties.name: flags
properties.description: Closed list: protected_character, logo, slogan, licensed_merch, lookalike_risk, story_text

properties.name: is_final
properties.description: True when the page was blocked after the re-roll

events.name: ip_output_rerolled
events.trigger: A flagged page was automatically re-rolled once with a hardened prompt.

properties.name: cost_usd
properties.description: Extra spend of the re-roll and its check

events.name: agent_grant_changed
events.trigger: A user connects, pauses, resumes or revokes an AI assistant's delegated access (OAuth grant).

properties.name: client_kind
properties.description: Mapped from the OAuth client id, never the raw id

events.name: agent_tool_called
events.trigger: Once per agent tool call after the policy decision (same point as the agent AuditLog row). Never the arguments; the audit log keeps only their digest.

properties.name: spend_reserved_usd
properties.description: Model spend reserved for this call

events.name: experiment_assigned
events.trigger: A unit is first bucketed into an experiment.
